diff --git a/lib/_mem/object-allocation.inc b/lib/_mem/object-allocation.inc
index f8b5179a..d075ff27 100644
--- a/lib/_mem/object-allocation.inc
+++ b/lib/_mem/object-allocation.inc
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-#line 1484 ___MEM_SOURCE_FILE
+#line 1491 ___MEM_SOURCE_FILE
 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
 /*
@@ -162,6 +162,13 @@ ___SIZE_TS bytes;)
         invoke_gc:
 #endif
 
+          /* Native release callbacks have an owner service, not a running
+           * Scheme activation. No nested collective can wait on this round.
+           * Return allocation failure before losing any initialization debt. */
+          if (___VMSTATE_FROM_PSTATE(___ps)->gc_participants[
+                ___PROCESSOR_ID(___ps,___VMSTATE_FROM_PSTATE(___ps))].phase
+              != ___GC_RUNNING)
+            return ___FIX(___HEAP_OVERFLOW_ERR);
           if (___garbage_collect (___PSP words))
             return ___FIX(___HEAP_OVERFLOW_ERR);
         }
